infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Metro Koi uses your location only while you share a metro ride, to show the train live for other riders.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you turn on ride detection in the background, Metro Koi notices when you are on the metro even with the app closed, to name your train and remind you of your stop. Only on the metro line; turn it off any time in Settings.

plugins.nfcPermission: Metro Koi reads your MRT Pass or Rapid Pass by NFC to show its balance and recent trips. Nothing is written to the card.
